function.name: delete_apdex_configuration
function.description: Deletes the Apdex (Application Performance Index) configuration by its unique identifier. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

id.description: The unique identifier of the Apdex configuration to be deleted.

function.name: apdex_settings_api_ApdexSettingsApi_create_apdex_configuration
function.description: Creates a new Apdex (Application Performance Index) configuration for monitoring and assessing the performance of applications. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

name.description: The name of the new Apdex configuration.

thresholds.description: Threshold values for categorizing the response times of applications.

satisfied.description: The maximum response time (in milliseconds) for a user to be considered satisfied.

tolerating.description: The maximum response time (in milliseconds) for a user to be considered tolerating before being frustrated.

include_samples.description: Flag to include performance samples in the Apdex calculation.

function.name: get_all_apdex_configurations
function.description: Retrieve a list of all Apdex score configurations from the system, providing an overview of application performance thresholds. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

application_id.description: Unique identifier of the application for which Apdex configurations are requested.

include_defaults.description: Flag to include default Apdex configurations in the response.
